payload.summary: Ward mockups end-to-end suite: 15 assertion failures on its first full run; one referral column clipped at 641px only, reproduced twice, and the suite is selected by neither verify:ui path
payload.detail: TWO RUNS NOW. Run 1 (whole suite): 2026-09-10 13:52 at 8b4b96fa9c, dev server, workers=1, 10.9 minutes. RECONCILED: 171 declared, 171 run - 151 passed + 15 failed + 5 skipped. Playwright exit 1. Run 2 (this spec only, confirmation): 2026-09-10 20:0x at 10c7414333, same dev server on port 3249 (identity confirmed via /api/local-project-id), workers=1, 17.7s. RECONCILED: 5 declared, 5 run - 3 passed + 2 failed + 0 skipped. Playwright exit 1, read directly and not through a pipe. The harness reported 'completed (exit code 0)' for run 1 because the command ended in echo; read the recorded exit= line, never the notice. In run 1 ALL 15 WERE ASSERTION FAILURES - toHaveURL, toHaveCount, toBeVisible, toEqual, element(s) not found. ZERO browser-loss or timeout. That is materially different from the previously recorded state (2026-09-06: 78 tests, 1 failure that WAS a browser lost under memory pressure), so that old note does not describe these runs and must not be used to explain them away. THREE WARD FAILURES IN RUN 1; the two in this spec both REPRODUCED IDENTICALLY in run 2. (a) ui-ward-referrals.spec.ts:1056 - ONE column of the queued referral table is clipped by about 17px at a 641px viewport. Reproduced byte-for-byte across both runs: 'Home region (right edge 623 vs scroller 606)' and 'Perth Metropolitan (right edge 623 vs scroller 606)'. *** WIDTHS NOW MEASURED - this closes a scope limit the previous version of this row correctly flagged as open. The spec walks 641, 700, 760 and 820 and expect throws at the first failure, so runs 1 and 2 both measured 641 ONLY. On 2026-09-10 at 10c7414333 the guard's own measurement (spec lines 1070-1092, reproduced verbatim without expect so nothing aborts) was run at all four widths against the same server. RESULT: 641px - queued table 12 cells measured, 2 clipped; 700px, 760px and 820px - queued table 12 cells measured, 0 clipped. The decided table (ward-referral-board-decided-table) measured 10 cells and 0 clipped at ALL FOUR widths. POSITIVE CONTROL SATISFIED: at 641px the instrument reproduced the spec's own two entries verbatim including the 623/606 geometry, so it can return a positive and its zeros carry information. So the defect is confined to 641px in the tested set; NOTHING is claimed about widths between or below those four, which were not measured. *** *** COUNT CORRECTION, CARRIED SO IT CANNOT BE RE-ASSERTED: two earlier versions of this row (7235af08, 03f090b7) said the guard 'permits one such entry and found four'. BOTH HALVES ARE FALSE. The assertion is .toEqual([]) at spec line 1096 - it permits ZERO. The received array holds TWO entries, not four: '- Expected - 1 / + Received + 4' are counts of DIFF LINES. And the two entries are one column reported twice - the guard collects thead th together with tbody tr:first-child td (spec line 1071), so 'Home region' is the column heading and 'Perth Metropolitan' the first data cell beneath it, at identical geometry. The all-widths measurement corroborates this independently: 12 cells for a 6-column table is 6 headings plus 6 first-row cells. *** *** EARLIER RETRACTION, ALSO RETAINED: the first version of this row claimed the overflow was 'the predictable consequence of an APPROVED change', citing owner-ruling-2026-09-07-board-columns.md and its five new columns. THAT WAS FALSE AND UNCHECKED. Presentation, Review status, Plan, Bed number and Legal form expiry do not exist anywhere in src/components/ward-management/ and belong to the ward BOARD, a different screen; this table's columns are Referral, Tier, Since referral, Age band, Sex, Home region. On that invented cause the finding was escalated to the owner twice as a decision only he could make. It is not. *** (b) ui-ward-referrals.spec.ts:414 - 'fixture assumption: the seed's queued referrals, in the queue's own order'. The test's hard-coded list holds 4 ids and the app produced 6; the two extra are RF-015 and RF-014. Reproduced identically in run 2. (An earlier version wrote this as 'expected 0 received 2', which are diff line counts, not list lengths - the same misreading as (a), reaching the right answer by coincidence.) Which side is right - the fixture or the seed - is UNCHECKED. (c) ui-ward-roles.spec.ts:559 - getByTestId('ward-ed-inbox-empty') not found for peel-ed; the handle IS declared and renderable at ed-screen.tsx:1305, so this is a STATE question, not a dead handle. NOT re-run in run 2, which covered ui-ward-referrals.spec.ts only. ed-screen.tsx and ward-referrals.ts are claimed on the register by Ward Builder One, whose in-flight work splits ED-addressed referrals into expects versus in-department - named as a hypothesis with evidence, NOT a diagnosis; nobody has read that change. TWELVE ARE OUTSIDE WARD FLOW and belong to their own programmes: ui-caring-contact-mockup (4), ui-tools-collapse (3), ui-tools-task-directory (2), ui-sidebar-live-mockup (2), ui-answer-chat-perfected-mockup (1). Owner stated 2026-09-10 that Caring Contacts is not part of this project; the twelve are recorded here only so the measurement stays whole, and Ward Flow is not routing them. SCOPE: (a) and (b) now have TWO reproductions on two different SHAs, not three on one SHA, so repository flake policy still does not permit quarantine and none is sought. Because test:e2e:pr takes --project=chromium plus the seeded project and grep-inverts @mockup, this suite is selected by neither verify:ui path and these failures may be weeks old; NOTHING HERE ASSERTS A RECENT REGRESSION. NEXT ACTION: owner deferred routing 2026-09-10. (a) is a narrow-window layout fix for a builder and is now fully characterised. (b) needs a ruling on whether the fixture or the seed is authoritative.
